subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should embedded `after_compaction` hooks receive a current-session-only deferred reset capability as a supported plugin contract?
rationale: This adds a new plugin-facing session mutation method; code review can constrain its safety, but only the compaction/context-engine owner can confirm that plugins should own this lifecycle decision rather than core or the context engine.

options.title: Sponsor after-compaction-only API
options.body: Approve the capability only on `after_compaction` contexts, with one drain after every owning compaction phase completes and focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Reject the plugin API and move the fresh-session decision into core or the context-engine contract so hooks remain observational.

options.title: Approve a general hook API
options.body: Intentionally expose reset to broader embedded hook contexts with explicit loop prevention, lifecycle semantics, documentation, and compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after-compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Approve the capability only on `after_compaction` contexts, with one drain after every owning compaction phase completes and focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository routes Compaction and Context Engine ownership to this person, and the decision spans both surfaces.
